scope: Executable CUDA recovery on an independently frozen, input-equivalent cohort
trackSeparation: PTX availability is extra information. Do not score a PTX emitter against a SASS-only lifter on unmatched inputs.

corpus.deduplication: source and independently reviewed canonical-program SHA-256; sizes, seeds, compiler outputs and renamed kernels are not new kernels
corpus.requiredMatrix: Every kernel on every frozen compiler/GPU pair; unsupported rows remain in the denominator
corpus.reasonBindingsAreNull: No 100-kernel corpus or final candidate has been frozen or executed by this protocol yet. Bind these in a separate preregistration before testing.

recovery.coverageEvaluation: Require the same gain on the complete cohort and independently on the untouched confirmation cohort; development gains cannot conceal confirmation failure
recovery.baseline: Strongest independently reproduced, licensed, input-equivalent baseline selected before confirmation
recovery.unavailableBaseline: unknown; never zero and never silently excluded from a broad SOTA claim
recovery.correctExecutable: Candidate emits CUDA C++ or executable IR without original-program passthrough, compiles, executes and agrees with independent references on all frozen cases
recovery.statistics: Report exact counts and uncertainty. Zero observed errors is not a universal correctness proof.

performance.baseline: original binary, current compiler and strongest applicable library on the same admitted workload

validation.confirmationReuse: One exposure per frozen candidate; further tuning consumes a new disjoint holdout
validation.authority: A JSON result, digest, local gate or consensus is not authenticated executor evidence, a semantic proof, approval or release permission.

rollback: Retain original artifacts; disable experimental executable recovery; preserve static inspection. No automatic merge, package publication or deployment.
